messages:
maya: ran PTQ canary on heron-v2 against the funcall-harness — observed ~0.9% schema fail rate in streaming mode. failures cluster: duplicate keys (user.id vs id), numeric->string flips, and occasional � before closing brace that breaks our ndjson merger.

maya: snippet captured from raw stream chunks:
```
chunkA: {"tool":"lookup","args":{"id":"99"}}
chunkB: {"tool":"lookup","args":{"id":"99","id":"099"}}
chunkC: {"tool":"lookup","args":{"id":"99","name":"bob", "�":""}}
```

ci-bot: canary summary: runs=3000 failures=27 duplicate_key=18 type_flip=5 trailing_null=4 -> alert threshold (1%) exceeded :rotating_light:

chet: can you paste the exact command + env so I can repro locally? :eyes:

maya: repro command: `./scripts/run_funcall_canary --model=heron-v2-ptq --mode=stream --seed=2026 --runs=3000` 
logs: s3://canary/runs/1766543210/

alina: quick read: sounds like two orthogonal problems — (A) PTQ tokenization changes cause different token boundaries for numeric sequences, producing multiple partial writes with the same key when merged; (B) streaming flusher may emit a C0 control char at chunk boundary when a buffer was memzeroed.

kevin: i suspect interaction of last week's quant rounding tweak (commit 7f3d2a) and the streaming flusher change (commit e9a78). try `QUANT_ROUND=old` and `STREAM_FLUSH=legacy` to isolate.

maya: tried: `QUANT_ROUND=old` -> failures down to 11; `STREAM_FLUSH=legacy` -> trailing_nulls drop to 0 but duplicate keys remain. both together -> failures=2.

sylvia: short-term mitigation: i'll add a canary-only stream postprocessor that merges adjacent json fragments, strips C0 control chars, and dedups keys (last-wins). will gate behind `STREAM_POST_DEDUPE=true`. low risk and keeps canary signals actionable.

chet: longer term: need to confirm tokenizer boundary change in PTQ path. @alina can you run a token-diff harness between ptq and baseline for the same seeds and small numeric-heavy prompts?

alina: on it — running token-diff with seed=2026. preliminary: numeric sequences like "123" split into ["12","3"] under ptq in ~0.7% of test cases vs baseline 0.0%. exporting diffs to s3://canary/runs/1766543210/token_diffs.tar.gz

ci-bot: created ticket ML-1234: "ptq-stream-suffix-null-and-duplicate-key-canary" and attached canary logs.

maya: plan: 1) merge sylvia's postprocessor to canary harness behind flag, 2) pin our canary runs to `QUANT_ROUND=old` while we triage, 3) schedule deep root-cause for tokenizer/quant interaction next sprint. will mute alerts until postprocessor is enabled. :thumbsup:

sylvia: PR draft up and assigned to @chet. includes unit tests for control-char stripping + duplicate-key collapse. will run a gated canary after merge and report numbers.

chet: will review today. if green we enable for canary-only, re-evaluate metrics, then decide rollback vs targeted fix for quant tokenizer.

maya: thanks everyone — leaving follow-ups in ML-1234 and linking raw captures.
